description: Blockchain-specific security requirements for government supply chain provenance, crosswalked to NIST 800-53 Rev 5

requirements.title: FIPS 140-2/3 Validated Cryptographic Modules
requirements.description: All cryptographic operations must use FIPS 140-2 or 140-3 validated modules

requirements.title: HSM for Key Storage (IL5+)
requirements.description: Private keys for blockchain identities must be stored in hardware security modules for IL5 and above

requirements.title: Approved Cryptographic Algorithms
requirements.description: Only NIST-approved algorithms (AES-256, SHA-256+, ECDSA P-256/P-384, RSA-3072+)

requirements.title: Key Rotation Policy
requirements.description: Cryptographic keys must have defined rotation schedules

requirements.title: Certificate Lifecycle Management
requirements.description: X.509 certificates for TLS and identity must have monitored expiration

BC-ACCESS.name: Blockchain Access Control
BC-ACCESS.description: Identity and access management for permissioned blockchain

requirements.title: MSP Identity Management
requirements.description: All participants must be enrolled through a Membership Service Provider with verified identity

requirements.title: Endorsement Policy Enforcement
requirements.description: All chaincodes must have explicit endorsement policies requiring multi-org approval

requirements.title: Channel Access Control Lists
requirements.description: Channel ACLs must restrict read/write access to authorized organizations

requirements.title: Least Privilege for Chaincode Invocation
requirements.description: Chaincode invocation policies must follow least privilege principle

requirements.title: Organization Role Separation
requirements.description: Admin, peer, client, and orderer roles must be separated per organization

requirements.title: Immutable Transaction Ledger
requirements.description: All transactions must be recorded in an immutable, append-only ledger

requirements.title: Transaction Logging
requirements.description: All chaincode invocations must be logged with actor identity, timestamp, and function name

requirements.title: Block Integrity Verification
requirements.description: Block hashes must be verified to detect tampering

requirements.title: Non-Repudiation
requirements.description: Transaction submissions must be cryptographically signed for non-repudiation

requirements.title: Audit Trail Export
requirements.description: Transaction history must be exportable for compliance reporting

BC-DATA.name: Blockchain Data Protection
BC-DATA.description: Data handling, privacy, and residency requirements

requirements.title: Private Data Collections for CUI
requirements.description: CUI data must use private data collections, not public channel state

requirements.title: Data Residency Enforcement
requirements.description: Blockchain data must reside in approved regions (GovCloud for IL4+)

requirements.title: Hash-Only On-Chain Storage
requirements.description: Only SHA-256 integrity proofs stored on-chain, never plaintext CUI

requirements.title: Private Data Purge Policy
requirements.description: Private data collections must have defined purge/retention policies

requirements.title: State Database Encryption
requirements.description: CouchDB/LevelDB state databases must be encrypted at rest

requirements.title: Mutual TLS Authentication
requirements.description: All peer-to-peer and peer-to-orderer communication must use mutual TLS

requirements.title: Peer Network Isolation
requirements.description: Peer nodes must be isolated in dedicated network segments

requirements.title: Orderer Service Security
requirements.description: Orderer nodes must be protected from unauthorized access and DoS

requirements.title: Gossip Protocol Security
requirements.description: Fabric gossip protocol must use TLS and organization-scoped messaging

requirements.title: External Connectivity Restrictions
requirements.description: Blockchain nodes must not have unrestricted internet access

requirements.title: Consortium Governance Policy
requirements.description: Multi-organization governance with defined voting/approval processes

requirements.title: Chaincode Approval Lifecycle
requirements.description: Chaincode deployment must follow install→approve→commit workflow with multi-org approval

requirements.title: Configuration Change Control
requirements.description: Channel and network configuration changes must be approved and audited

requirements.title: Chaincode Version Control
requirements.description: All chaincode versions must be tracked with immutable deployment history

requirements.title: Smart Contract Security Review
requirements.description: All chaincode must pass security audit before deployment approval
